system.description:
7th Level Clan Feature, [Reckless Branch]

You detonate your charges while in point blank range. You gain the second nature release you didn’t select from Explosion Release Affinity clan trait and when casting a jutsu with either Lightning or Earth Release keywords, you can change the damage type to force.

You learn three Payloads, and choose which two you have prepared after each rest. Unless a payload says otherwise, affected creatures must make a Dexterity saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC. You learn 2 more Payloads at 11th level and can prepare three to use after each rest. You are immune to your own Payload effects.

You can detonate a single Primed creature instead of all creatures by dealing [Unarmed Damage] to them and these payloads can change the shape of the affected area.

When you detonate Primed creatures, objects and structures you can select one Payload infusing their effect into the detonation itself. Only one detonation will have the Payload effect.

B1 Knuckle Burst

Knuckle Burst. If the detonation is triggered by [Unarmed Damage], its affected area becomes a 30-foot cone originating from you. Creatures who fail their saving throw gain 1 rank of Shaken.

B2 Armor Crack

Armor Crack. If the detonation is triggered by [Unarmed Damage], its affected area becomes a 60-foot line originating from you. Creatures who fail their saving throw reduce their AC by 2 until the end of your next turn.

B3 Flash bang

Flash Bang. If the detonation is triggered by [Unarmed Damage], its affected area becomes a 20-foot cube originating from you. Creatures who fail their saving throw are Blinded until the end of their next turn.

B4 Ear Ringer

Ear Ringer. If the detonation is triggered by [Unarmed Damage], its affected area becomes a 30-foot cone originating from you. Creature who fail their saving throw are Deafened and gain 2 ranks of Concussed.

B5 Barrier Buster

Barrier Buster. If the detonation is triggered by [Unarmed Damage], its affected area becomes a 60-foot-long line originating from you. Creature who fail their saving throw have effects they are benefiting from as a result of a jutsu with the Barrier keyword dispelled, before damage is calculated.
